title: Your first test
summary: Open the home page and check what a user sees first: the tab title and the main heading.
why: A first test proves the whole chain works (runner → browser → app → assertion). In manual QA this is your smoke check; automated, it runs on every change in seconds.
objectives: Navigate with page.goto('/') (baseURL is configured for you)
Assert the title with await expect(page).toHaveTitle(...)
Assert the h1 with a role locator and toBeVisible()
hints: The exact title is 'Home · QA Practice Shop'.
pitfalls: Forgetting await on expect(...) — the test 'passes' before the check runs.
expect(await page.title()).toBe(...) reads the title once and never retries.
teachAlong: Effect: Playwright reports the exact failing line if the title changes.
Gate: runs your test 3× and checks the assertions are web-first.

requires.reason: Assert the tab title with await expect(page).toHaveTitle('Home · QA Practice Shop').
Find the heading the way a user (or screen reader) does: page.getByRole('heading', { name: … }).

wrongSolutions.label: missing await on assertion
non-retrying title check
wrong expected title
